china-1925-6:p0969_1.rationale: Annual values of direct imports by commodity group (cotton, woollen, metals, sundries), declared and recalculated at 1913 values.

china-1925-6:p0970_1.rationale: Annual values of direct exports including re-exports, declared and recalculated at 1913 values.

china-1925-6:p0972_1.rationale: Gross imports, Chinese and foreign produce exports and grand total of China's foreign trade by year.

china-1925-6:p0974_1.rationale: Lists the coast lighting districts and their geographic limits; the content is textual descriptions of limits.
